lifecycle_summary: Model the extant Pi Kappa Phi Omega house at 330 N Grant, not the proposed replacement. The demolition/replacement proposal received zoning variances in May 2026, but the public material reviewed here does not establish a demolition or construction permit or completed replacement. Chapter primary-source posts show house events at the same address in August 2026.

evidence.source: Tippecanoe County Area Board of Zoning Appeals, BZA-2225 May 27, 2026 minutes
evidence.finding: The board heard BZA-2225 for the Omega Chapter of Pi Kappa Phi and approved all six requested variances: votes were 5-0, 4-1, and four 5-0. The matter was not continued; the May packet's June continuance note belongs to another agenda item.
evidence.relevance: Confirms zoning approval for requested dimensions/setbacks/coverage/parking for the proposed replacement. It is not a demolition or building permit.

evidence.source: Tippecanoe County Area Board of Zoning Appeals, BZA-2225 staff report in May 27 packet
evidence.finding: Staff report dated May 21 says petitioner plans to tear down the existing fraternity and construct a new building at 330 North Grant. It describes the current house as built in 1928, Tudor-inspired, and historically significant in staff's opinion; the replacement would be much larger and use more modern facade materials.
evidence.relevance: Lifecycle evidence for a proposed future replacement; not evidence the replacement was built.

evidence.source: Pi Kappa Phi Omega chapter official 2026 news archive / recruitment reports
evidence.finding: Official posts dated August 23-24, 2026 state fall recruitment and chapter events were hosted at the house at 330 N Grant, including a house tour week.
evidence.relevance: Primary-source evidence that the chapter was actively using the extant house after the May BZA vote.

evidence.source: City of West Lafayette Building Department
evidence.finding: The City Building Department says permits are required for new construction and directs permit questions/status to its building department and online services. A targeted public-web search for an issued demolition/building permit at 330 N Grant did not surface a matching record. No permit application/status record was independently obtained in this review.
evidence.relevance: Permit status remains unverified; do not infer that no permit exists.

modeling_decision: Retain the currently modeled extant house because dated official chapter activity places events at this house in August 2026. Do not substitute the variance proposal or assert demolition. Add a lifecycle note that replacement was proposed and zoning variances were granted; future asset refresh requires permit/construction evidence.
limitations: Zoning variances authorize relief from zoning requirements, not demolition or construction by themselves.
Permit status is unresolved because no permit record or direct building-department confirmation was obtained.
Official chapter activity at the address is strong evidence of house use, but does not prove every part of the photographed facade was unchanged after that date.
